changelog.pl: Okno Stream Deck nazywa się teraz „Stream Deck i Companion”, a zakładka „WebSocket/HTTP API” — „Companion / API”. Od razu widać, gdzie ustawia się Bitfocus Companion.
changelog.en: The Stream Deck window is now called "Stream Deck & Companion" and the "WebSocket/HTTP API" tab is "Companion / API" - it is clear where Bitfocus Companion is set up.
